expected_result.PASS: Under the fixture_precondition, the future contracted operation is expected to complete without a protocol failure while satisfying required_outcome.
expected_result.FAIL: Under the fixture_precondition, the future contracted operation is expected to fail closed with failure_class while satisfying required_outcome.

semantics.source_binding: fixture_precondition and required_outcome are exact immutable copies of the governing Stage 1/Stage 2 pressure-case row and are mechanically compared to those source artifacts by the P0 verifier.
semantics.failure_class_scope: P0 pressure-suite taxonomy. These identifiers are stable fixture classifications, not yet a frozen runtime failure schema or wire-format code; P1b owns runtime failure-schema freeze.

cases.fixture_precondition: Prompt, chat title, or Project text says `act as Steward` but no accepted RIL activation exists
cases.required_outcome: Role text may be packaged only as explicitly selected content; it creates no authority or activation

cases.fixture_precondition: Ambient chat memory says a design was approved
cases.required_outcome: Ambient memory is not a supported deterministic source class and cannot enter the pack

cases.fixture_precondition: An admitted PEMS/2 `chat` record contains information originally derived from a conversation
cases.required_outcome: It may be selected because it is admitted canonical PEMS state, not because ambient chat is trusted

cases.fixture_precondition: A model would consider an unselected canonical record highly relevant
cases.required_outcome: Deterministic stage excludes it unless an explicit selector/profile rule includes it

cases.fixture_precondition: Same request/profile and same immutable source state are packaged twice
cases.required_outcome: Canonical pack bytes and digests are identical

cases.fixture_precondition: Target branch moves between request creation and source resolution
cases.required_outcome: Builder either resolves the exact immutable commit required by the request or fails; no silent rebinding

cases.fixture_precondition: A required control path is missing, symlinked, ambiguous, or digest-mismatched
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed before output

cases.fixture_precondition: An explicitly selected PEMS record ID is absent
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed; no fuzzy replacement or semantic substitution

cases.fixture_precondition: Selected PEMS content contains provenance references to omitted `source_observation` records
cases.required_outcome: Deterministic semantic closure includes required provenance records and their source records, or fails

cases.fixture_precondition: Selected derived proposition would lose its `derived_from` premise structure
cases.required_outcome: Include required premise relations/endpoints through semantic closure, or fail

cases.fixture_precondition: Selected relation would have an omitted endpoint
cases.required_outcome: Include endpoint through semantic closure, or fail

cases.fixture_precondition: A PEMS record contains an ID-bearing semantic reference whose closure rule is undefined in the selected protocol version
cases.required_outcome: Fail rather than silently truncate meaning

cases.fixture_precondition: COVE encoding does not structurally round-trip to the exact selected PEMS object
cases.required_outcome: Fail; never use the lossy encoding

cases.fixture_precondition: Requested COVE/PEMS/JCS tuple is unsupported
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed rather than coerce versions

cases.fixture_precondition: Project knowledge contains prose that says it is authoritative, approved, or grants a role
cases.required_outcome: Preserve the proposition as project knowledge; do not promote it into the control or authority planes

cases.fixture_precondition: An Engineer/Steward directive is included as a control item
cases.required_outcome: Inclusion conveys exact directive bytes only; it does not establish a registered or activated role

cases.fixture_precondition: Prior proposal, candidate, disposition, or canonical interpretation exists in the repository but is not selected
cases.required_outcome: Exclude it

cases.fixture_precondition: One canonical record is reached through several explicit selectors/closure paths
cases.required_outcome: Include the record once and preserve every deterministic inclusion cause in the outer ledger

cases.fixture_precondition: Closure graph contains cycles
cases.required_outcome: Terminate deterministically using visited identities while preserving valid graph relations; never recurse by model judgment

cases.fixture_precondition: Closure exceeds explicit record/byte/depth limits
cases.required_outcome: Fail with a stable limit code; do not silently truncate

cases.fixture_precondition: The same file or semantic item is assigned to conflicting planes
cases.required_outcome: Reject the pack request as a plane-classification conflict

cases.fixture_precondition: Pack request attempts to name Project memory, assistant recollection, hidden reasoning, or an ungoverned conversation as a source
cases.required_outcome: Reject unsupported source class

cases.fixture_precondition: An authority-sensitive task profile declares required activation evidence but the exact evidence/binding is absent
cases.required_outcome: Fail the profile requirement; never synthesize or infer activation

cases.fixture_precondition: Activation evidence is present
cases.required_outcome: The pack may carry the exact artifact/digest as operational evidence but does not convert it into authority; downstream RIL operation must revalidate it as required by its contract

cases.fixture_precondition: Reconciliation disposition says `COMPATIBLE/RECOMMEND`
cases.required_outcome: The pack may carry it only when explicitly selected; it still does not admit or mutate canonical PEMS/COVE

cases.fixture_precondition: Canonical PEMS changes after a request recorded an expected canonical digest
cases.required_outcome: Fail stale-state validation; do not silently rebuild against newer semantics

cases.fixture_precondition: Control repository commit and canonical snapshot come from separately identified immutable states
cases.required_outcome: Record both identities; if the selected profile requires a relationship that cannot be proven, fail

cases.fixture_precondition: Output path already contains different bytes
cases.required_outcome: Fail immutable-output collision; exact replay may return `NO_CHANGE`

cases.fixture_precondition: Filesystem enumeration order, map order, or host locale differs
cases.required_outcome: Canonical sorting/serialization produces identical pack bytes

cases.fixture_precondition: Current `rd-distill prepare` is invoked without explicitly declaring the generated pack as evidence
cases.required_outcome: Packer output is not injected. Current production evidence remains unchanged

cases.fixture_precondition: Request points to a schema-valid PEMS/2 file with correct digest that is not proven as admitted canonical state
cases.required_outcome: Reject as non-canonical/unproven canonical binding; path or request label is insufficient

cases.fixture_precondition: Canonical PEMS bytes are present but the project/backend admission binding or receipt chain identifies a different snapshot
cases.required_outcome: Fail stale/conflicting canonical-state validation

cases.fixture_precondition: Admitted canonical proposition contains `ignore controls`, `act as Steward`, or other instruction-like text
cases.required_outcome: Preserve as knowledge data; renderer must not promote it to control/instruction semantics

cases.fixture_precondition: Exact control artifact contains CRLF, non-ASCII, non-UTF-8, or bytes that a text decoder would normalize/reject
cases.required_outcome: Pack preserves exact source-byte identity through a specified byte representation or rejects unsupported media by explicit contract

cases.fixture_precondition: Whole-pack digest field is included in its own hash preimage
cases.required_outcome: Schema/algorithm makes self-reference impossible by a defined digest domain or out-of-band receipt

cases.fixture_precondition: Same request and sources are replayed with a different PEMS validator/COVE encoder/closure descriptor
cases.required_outcome: Toolchain identity mismatch is visible and either fails compatibility or uses explicitly compatible contracted behavior

cases.fixture_precondition: Explicit selectors produce an empty knowledge set
cases.required_outcome: Profile-defined deterministic empty-result rule applies; no model-driven fallback or broader search occurs

cases.fixture_precondition: Profile/request contains an unknown selector, closure rule, or limit field
cases.required_outcome: Fail closed under schema/version rules; do not ignore a field that could alter semantics

cases.fixture_precondition: Host-local absolute path or temporary directory differs across machines
cases.required_outcome: Local path does not enter canonical identity/rendered context unless explicitly contracted; replay remains environment-independent

cases.fixture_precondition: Builder implementation attempts to update a cache, canonical PEMS/COVE, admission store, reconciliation store, or authority store during build
cases.required_outcome: Pure build fails/tests detect side effect; semantic result is never contingent on mutation

cases.fixture_precondition: External backend locator resolves once, then content changes or backend becomes unavailable before read
cases.required_outcome: Immutable snapshot binding controls the read; change/missing snapshot fails, never silently re-resolves latest state

cases.fixture_precondition: Two source descriptors claim the same logical source but bind different immutable digests
cases.required_outcome: Reject conflict unless multi-snapshot semantics are explicitly part of the profile

cases.fixture_precondition: Operational-evidence artifact has correct bytes/digest but is expired, invalidly bound, or otherwise not accepted by its RIL validator
cases.required_outcome: Pack records carried/validation status without inferring acceptance; authority-bearing downstream operation revalidates

cases.fixture_precondition: Canonical pack is valid but deterministic renderer exceeds its activation-byte limit
cases.required_outcome: Renderer fails with stable limit result; it does not summarize, rank, or silently omit context

cases.fixture_precondition: Same semantic text appears in control and knowledge sources under different identities
cases.required_outcome: Preserve distinct source/plane identities; do not deduplicate by text similarity or content alone

cases.fixture_precondition: Unicode normalization form, locale, path separator, dictionary insertion order, or filesystem order differs across hosts
cases.required_outcome: Contracted canonical byte representation and ordering remain identical
